title: Wishma - The Blessing
overview: Twelve-year-old Wishma, who relies on his three best friends to cope with the bullying he faces for being fatherless, discovers that his long-lost father might still be alive. Soon after this revelation, a mysterious woman grants him three magical wishes, warning that they must be used unselfishly and will only last for seven days. However, after a humiliating encounter with bullies, Wishma impulsively uses his first wish to become an adult and wakes up completely unrecognizable to his own mother. Frightened, he flees to his friends for help, and once they realize the magic is real, the group embarks on a heartwarming adventure to use the remaining wishes to track down Wishma's father and reunite his fractured family.
